metadata.description: The official KlickTipp plugin for Claude and Codex.

plugins.name: klicktipp
plugins.description: KlickTipp toolkit: write, review and prepare KlickTipp email newsletters — drafts, block-by-block content, split tests, audience, sender, test sends and the dispatch confirmation — and work with the account's contact data: contacts, manual tags, custom fields and opt-in processes, over the KlickTipp MCP server.
